name: TPC Benchmark E (TPC-E)
description: A standardized OLTP benchmark that measures transactional database performance (throughput, latency, and scalability) under a complex, business-oriented workload.
general_score_metric: tpmC (transactions per minute, TPC-E specific metric)
typical_sota_score: varies widely; published systems report from thousands to millions of tpmC depending on hardware and tuning
reputation: Industry-standard OLTP benchmark with long-standing adoption for database performance evaluation and vendor/academic publishable results.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on database systems; results are highly sensitive to hardware/configuration and tuning (risk of benchmark-specific optimizations), making cross-system comparisons nontrivial.
